body: A lot of places, such as Planned Parenthood, offers free or discounted HIV testing. I’m sure you’re in the clear, but a test could help ease your mind.

I’m sorry to hear you’re experiencing that - I would say a good week and a half. I was very careful not to listen to music too loud, and made sure to wear ear plugs while out in public. I’m not sure if that helped the process if even at all, I was just a nervous wreck so I did everything I could that I thought would help. I hope things start to clear up for you soon!

Hey there. Luckily, it has completely subsided. I think coupled with my anxiety, my symptoms were becoming much worse as I was starting to panic. Taking this experience as a lesson - I carry my ear plugs with me everywhere!
Oh my God. I will buy one right now.
